thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate from streaming endpoint (POST /v1/stream). Trigger threshold crossed at 1719504300. Routing to on-call ameera.
omeera: taking this — joining incident channel. quick triage in progress.
jordan: saw a spike in connection pool errors on stream proxy nodes, DB connections look fine. starting to tail logs.
omeera: can you confirm whether non-streaming text-gen is impacted?
jordan: non-streaming endpoints look nominal. error profile is ConnectionReset + upstream 503 from stream shard.
sophia: grabbing a draft for the public page so CS has something to send out. will paste below.
sophia: ```
[Investigating]
Service: Hosted Streaming API (SSE / chunked responses)
Impact: Partial — a subset of streaming requests may receive 5xx errors or truncated streams. Non-streaming text-gen is unaffected.
Customers affected: Some chat/streaming sessions (estimated ~1-3% of global requests), higher rate in us-west-2 cluster.
Start: ~1719504300 UTC
Status: Engineers investigating root cause and mitigations.
Next update: 30 minutes or sooner.
```
mike: CS note: please include recommended workaround for customers — suggest toggling to non-streaming endpoint or retrying with backoff. I'll draft a customer DM once we confirm wording.
jordan: identified likely culprit: socket exhaustion due to a recent proxy config change that reduced max concurrent upstream connections. rolling a temporary increase now.
omeera: reconfig applied to two busiest shards. watching error rate.
jordan: error rate dropping from 2.8% -> 0.9% on shards we've patched, still elevated on 1 shard.
kate: can we publish an initial statement now saying "partial degradation" with ETA for next update? ops needs comms window.
neil: security ok with publishing this level of detail. avoid mentioning internal config names.
sophia: updated draft to remove internal bits. new draft: ```
[Investigating]
Service: Streaming API
Impact: Partial — streaming responses may intermittently fail with 5xx errors; non-streaming requests are largely unaffected.
Scope: Approx 1-3% of streaming requests, concentrated in us-west-2.
Mitigation: Engineers are applying configuration changes and monitoring. Temporary workaround: use non-streaming endpoints or retry logic.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have a resolution.
```

mike: CS draft for customers: "We’re investigating intermittent failures for streaming responses. If your integration relies on streaming, consider switching to the non-streaming endpoint as a temporary workaround. We’ll follow up soon with ETA"

neil: approved.

nameera: metrics stable for 1h. I’m marking incident as resolved in ops channel.
sophia: resolved draft: ```
[Resolved]
Incident: Partial failures for Streaming API (POST /v1/stream)
Impact: Intermittent 5xx errors for streaming responses, affecting ~1-3% of requests in us-west-2.
Root cause: Upstream connection pool configuration that limited concurrent upstream connections after a recent config change.
Resolution: Configuration increased and rolled to all shards. Error rates returned to baseline.
Time to recovery: ~35 minutes from detection to full roll.
Follow-up: Post-incident action items created to add safer rollout guardrails and a canary for proxy config changes.
```
